evidence_root_policy: Paths are repository-relative; preserve original immutable evidence bytes and use a root mapping rather than rewriting hash-bound files.
reproduction_boundary: Original measured dt, action and per-case base/scene/layout transform are recorded separately from CLI defaults.

Recorded CLI uses the actual recorded max_steps; current code may need a separately authorized/revalidated 12000-step setting because timestep/profile evolved.
No model evaluation or distribution generalization is implied.
